reroll_token.effectText: The next shop reroll costs 1 less Gold.

coupon_stamp.effectText: The next item or Jester purchase costs 2 less Gold.

two_pair_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Two Pair growth +1.

triple_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Triple growth +1.

straight_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Straight growth +1.

flush_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Flush growth +1.

full_house_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Full House growth +1.

four_kind_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Four of a Kind growth +1.

straight_flush_study.effectText: Use in the shop to give Straight Flush growth +1.

line_memory.effectText: Choose a scoring line. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

board_scrap.effectText: Gain +1 board discard for this Station.

hand_scrap.effectText: Gain +1 hand discard for this Station.

line_polish.effectText: The next confirm final score is multiplied by x1.25.

straight_oil.effectText: The next run-line confirm gains +40 Chips.

flush_powder.effectText: The next same-color confirm gains score +40%.

pair_splint.effectText: The next Two Pair confirm gains +35 Chips.

overlap_pin.effectText: The next confirm gets a slightly higher overlap bonus cap.

emergency_draw.effectText: If your hand is empty, create 1 random tile without consuming the deck.

ledger_clip.effectText: Gain +1 Gold when entering the shop.

discard_glove.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 board discard.

mulligan_sleeve.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 hand discard.

score_abacus.effectText: The first confirm in each Station gains +30 Chips.

thin_caliper.effectText: Confirms made with 3 or fewer tiles gain score +20%.

stage_map.effectText: Clearing a Showdown gives +1 reward Gold.

merchant_stamp.effectText: When entering the shop, the first reroll costs 1 less Gold.

safety_net.effectText: Once per Station, prevent the first combat lock that would end the run.

coin_funnel.effectText: At settlement, each unused board discard gives +1 reward Gold.

hand_funnel.effectText: At settlement, each unused hand discard gives +1 reward Gold.

echo_bell.effectText: The second confirm in each Station adds 10% of the first confirm score.

boss_trophy.effectText: After clearing a Showdown, the next shop has +1 Jester offer.

thin_wallet.effectText: Use only at 3 Gold or less. Gain +5 Gold.

jester_invoice.effectText: The next Jester purchase costs 4 less Gold.

item_invoice.effectText: The next item purchase costs 4 less Gold.

red_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each red tile gives score +10%.

blue_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each blue tile gives score +10%.

black_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each black tile gives score +10%.

yellow_swatch.effectText: On the next confirm, each yellow tile gives score +10%.

rank_chalk.effectText: On the next confirm, each tile sharing a number gives +12 Chips.

deck_needle.effectText: Look at the top 3 deck tiles and discard 1.

battle_pouch.effectText: Max hand size +1 for this Battle.

tile_polisher.effectText: The first scored tile in each Station gains +20 Chips.

move_token.effectText: Gain +1 board move for this Station.

slide_wax.effectText: The next board move also triggers slide bonus effects.

board_lift.effectText: Reserve +1 board move for the next Station.

undo_seal.effectText: Undo the last board move once.

organizer_glove.effectText: At each Station start, gain +1 board move.

wide_grip.effectText: At each Station start, max hand size +1 and board discard -1.

grand_satchel.effectText: At each Station start, max hand size +2 and hand discard -1.

market_compass.effectText: When entering the shop, discount the cheaper first offer between item and Jester offers by 1 Gold.

cross_memory.effectText: Mark one crossing scoring tile. If that tile later scores as an overlap tile, gain extra hand-rank growth.

keystone_copy.effectText: Choose any board line. Add its center scoring tile to the top of your deck.

edge_copy.effectText: Choose an endpoint scoring tile from any board line. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

rank_echo.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a random-color tile with the same number to the top of your deck.

color_echo.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a random-number tile with the same color to the top of your deck.

scarce_copy.effectText: Choose a scoring tile from any board line. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

sealed_copy.effectText: Choose a sealed or enhanced scoring tile. Add a copy to the top of your deck.

fate_three_kind_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a three-of-a-kind set using the line's highest number; the other numbers do not overlap.

fate_straight_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the lowest straight set possible from the line's lowest tile, with that tile off-color.

fate_straight_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the highest straight set possible from the line's highest tile, with that tile off-color.

fate_flush_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a flush set using the line's lowest tile color.

fate_flush_high.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a flush set using the line's highest tile color.

fate_full_house_low.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a full house with the second-lowest number as triple and highest number as pair.

rank_concord.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a full house with the highest number as triple and next-highest number as pair.

step_rite.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a four-of-a-kind set using the line's lowest number.

color_concord.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a four-of-a-kind set using the line's highest number.

off_color_rite.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the lowest straight-flush set possible from the line's lowest tile.

wild_thread.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into the highest straight-flush set possible from the line's highest tile.

number_mask.effectText: Choose a board line. If the line has a 1 tile, use that tile color; otherwise use the highest tile color. Transform it into a same-color 10-11-12-13-1 royal flush set.

flush_house_fate.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a same-color full house using the highest and next-highest numbers.

flush_five_fate.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into five same-color copies of the highest number.

line_pruner.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a three-of-a-kind set using the second-lowest number; the other numbers do not overlap.

trim_color.effectText: Choose a tile from any board line. Remove off-color tiles from that line, then put the same number of matching-color tiles on top of your deck.

trim_rank.effectText: Choose a board line. Transform it into a two-pair set using the highest and next-highest numbers.

deadwood_burn.effectText: Choose any board line. Clear its board tiles and gain Gold +3.

sacrifice_line.effectText: Choose any board line. Clear it and copy 2 of its tiles onto the top of your deck.

cross_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring crossing line. This confirm gives that line score +25%.

corner_rite.effectText: Choose a board line containing a corner. Copy one endpoint tile to your deck.

center_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring line containing the center. Its current hand rank gains growth +1.

diagonal_rite.effectText: Choose a scoring diagonal line. This confirm gives that line score +35%.

bridge_rite.effectText: Choose a shared crossing tile. Add a bridge seal; each overlapping scoring line gains Gold +2.

ritual_coupon.effectText: The next item purchase costs 2 less Gold.

ritual_lens.effectText: Reroll current item offers and favor ritual choices.

line_pack_ticket.effectText: Add one extra item offer slot in the next Market.

seal_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.

prune_vendor.effectText: The next item purchase costs 1 less Gold.
